text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond missed out on 1st place. 
Her legs were heavy with fatigue near the 
end, and she felt frustrated with herself 
for barely managing to finish the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cause of the fatigue was having to run 
all the way to the racetrack to avoid 
being late due to traffic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond wondered if this too was 
because of the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she fired herself up, determined to 
overcome any jinx and seize victory with a 
flawless run in the upcoming Japanese 
Derby.
